name: Scandinavian Qd6 — White Tactics
description: 4 strategic challenges for White in the Scandinavian Qd6 Variation. Find the right plan from move 9 onwards!

drills.name: Qxb7: The Queen Raid
drills.description: White to play. Black’s queenside is loose — the queen goes shopping and comes home with the exchange.
drills.briefExplanation: Qxb7! starts a raid: the queen grabs the b-pawn, then the a8-rook, and escapes before it gets trapped.
drills.explanation: Black to move. There is a real tactic here: Qxb7 winning the exchange or more. Line: 1. Qxb7 O-O 2. Qxa8 Nc6 3. Qb7. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +3.65 for Black, 2.48 pawns better than the next-best alternative.
